title: Abbas Mar Gaye
body:
Abbas mar gaye Ali akbar juda hua, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
*Dashte bala me shah ye padhte the
marsiya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na
pucha k kya hua,
1. Qasim rahe na, auno mohammad guzar gaye, Asghar mri nigah k aage hi mar gaye, Ik dopaher me mera bhara ghar ujad gaya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
2. kis bebasi se pahucha mai lashe pisar pe Haye, Dushman ko bhi khuda na kbhi aisa din dikhaye, Bete ko apne dasht me mai dhundta rha, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
3. duniya ne mujhse chheen liya mere sher ko, Pyasa hi qatl krdiya mere diler ko, Lasha bhi uska khaime me mai la nahi saka, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
4. be rahem hogye hain musalman is qadar, Terah baras k bache ka sar tan se kaat kr, Lasha bhi uska ghodo se Pamal krdiya Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
5. Allah tujhko bakhshe kbhi na aye hurmala, wo teer teen bhaal ka besheer ka gala, hatho pe mere mar gaya lakhte jigar mera, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
6. lasho pe lash lata rha hu mai bar bar, Ghurbat to meri dekh le aye rabbe kirdegar, Mai ro rha tha lasho pe hanste the ashqiya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua
7. ya rab koi bhi mujhsa ghareebul watan na ho, Aise Kheza'n raseeda kisi ka chaman na ho, Dashte bala me chhut gaye sab mere aqraba Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
8. bahti rahi furat nigaho k samne, Bache mre tadapte rhe Phir Bhi pyas se, Mujhpe paraye des me Kya kya sitam pada Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
9. ghurbat me the jo sath wo sathi guzar gaye, Mai ji k kya kru mere Ansar mar gaye, Ik ek kr k hogye sab Yaar bhi juda, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
10. bache hain tadpe pyas se bahlau kis tarah, sharminda hu khayam me mai jau kis tarah, Kaisa ye imtehan h aye mere kibriya, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua,
11. suhail apne sir ko jhukaye hue Husain, Khaliq ki bargaah me krte rhe ye bain, karbal me aake lut gaya ghar baar sab mera, Mujhse kisi ne ye bhi na pucha k kya hua.
